subject: Defining success thresholds and ops runway for Altura POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@alturasys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Defining success thresholds and ops runway for Altura POC

Hi Daniel / Sarah —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed acceptance matrix so we can lock the POC scope and owners. I tried to keep this tight so we can start the perf runs next week.

1) Goal (what success looks like)
- Realtime summarization endpoint integrated in Altura staging with:
  • P95 latency <= 280ms for 512-token responses (measured at 95th percentile over 10k requests)
  • Sustained throughput >= 10 req/s under realistic concurrency (burst to 25 req/s)
  • Cost target <= $0.0018 / token (endpoint-level blended)
  • Quality: pass Altura curated eval (sample prompts attached) with >= 92% accuracy on classification/intent checks and no% major hallucinations (>2%)

2) Proposed POC timeline (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize plan & access (we need staging VPC peering + sample dataset)
- Week 1: baseline perf runs + initial tuning (quantized model options)
- Week 2: integration smoke tests with live traffic mirror (~10% traffic)
- Week 3: quality readout & acceptance testing
- Week 4: wrap & rollout recommendations + ops handoff

3) Owners (single point for each area)
- Redwood perf lead: Ben Carter (benchmarks, tuning, perf reports)
- Customer success / onboarding: Rishi Malhotra (SLA runbook, failover policy)
- Altura technical lead: Daniel Park (data access, sample prompts, staging validation)

4) Requirements / blockers we flagged on the call
- Staging VPC peering + ephemeral keys for vault access
- Confirmation of sample prompt set + golden labels (Sarah to confirm)
- Any data-retention or audit constraints (Daniel to share security questionnaire answers)

Attached: altura-poc-eval-plan.xlsx (contains test definitions, measurement scripts) and altura-sample-prompts.csv.

Next steps I propose:
- Daniel/Sarah: confirm sample set and grant staging access by Monday EOD (26 Jul)
- Ben: kick off baseline perf run as soon as we have access (target Tue 28 Jul)
- Rishi: prepare onboarding checklist and SLA draft (shared by Wed)

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for the perf window and a short Slack channel for real-time ops.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick notes from our side:

- The thresholds look reasonable; we agree to target the latency/throughput numbers you proposed as the go/no-go for the POC.
- One ask: we need to confirm data retention and encryption-at-rest details before we start (SOC2 controls + retention policy for logs). Can you share the short security one-pager?
- We will validate the sample prompt set — Sarah will own labeling and will get the golden labels back to you by Mon 26 Jul.
- Regarding cost: Altura needs a simple cost-estimate for 1M tokens/month with both 8-bit and 4-bit quantized variants so we can compare. Is that something Ben can produce from the baseline run?

Thanks — looking forward to the perf run.

—Daniel
